papers.title_en: RISR: Residual-Informed Scientific Equation Discovery with Large Language Models
papers.authors: Haobo Li, Wenshuo Zhang, Wenxiao Zhao, Eunseo Jung, Rui Sheng, Yushi Sun, Peiqin Zhuang, Hao Chen, Fenghua Ling
papers.evidence: 残差信息引导的符号回归方程发现
papers.tldr: 符号回归结合结构搜索与数值拟合，但总体拟合分数无法揭示误差在输入间的分布。RISR以残差模式指导公式发现：残差编码器将输入、目标、预测和残差压缩为连续词元，条件化大语言模型生成公式；双视角关系编码器再预测候选修正的拟合后效用。在LLM-SRBench上，RISR在1%和0.1%逐点相对误差容限下取得63.57%和38.50%的ID准确率，OOD为56.07%和38.24%，优于同骨干基线，说明残差信息能提升数值方程恢复。
papers.abstract_en: Symbolic regression combines structural search with numerical fitting, but aggregate fit scores do not describe how the remaining error varies across inputs. We introduce RISR, a residual-informed method that uses these error patterns to guide formula discovery and learn which corrections are worth fitting. A residual encoder compresses aligned inputs, targets, current predictions, and residuals into continuous tokens that condition a language model to propose formulas. For subsequent refinement, a dual-view relational encoder uses additive and regularized multiplicative residuals to predict the post-fit utility of candidate corrections. We evaluate RISR on scientific tasks from the LLM-SRBench. RISR achieves 63.57% and 38.50% ID accuracy at the 1% and 0.1% pointwise relative-error tolerances, respectively. The corresponding OOD accuracies are 56.07% and 38.24%. RISR outperforms the reported baselines using the same backbone. The results show that our residual-informed approach can improve numerical equation recovery.
